title: Forms
description: Build the request forms people fill in from the portal, with conditional fields and an optional approval workflow.

actions.title: What happens next
actions.description: Actions run in the background once a request is sent, approved or rejected. Failed ones are retried, and every request shows what its actions did.
actions.emptyHint: Raise a change, grant a role, notify people or call another system when a request is approved.
actions.pickerDescription: Choose what the form does. You configure it next.
actions.someNotAllowed: {count, plural, one {# more action needs} other {# more actions need}} a permission you don't have.
actions.onHint: After approval and after rejection follow the form's approval workflow.
actions.noApprovalHint: This form has no approval workflow: "After approval" actions run as soon as a request is sent, and "After rejection" ones never run.
actions.name: Name (optional)
actions.nameHint: Shown on the request instead of the action's own name.
actions.whenHint: The action runs only when these hold for the request at that moment (the answers, what approvers filled in, the requester). Otherwise it shows as skipped.
actions.whenEmpty: No conditions: runs for every request.
actions.whenIncomplete: Fill in the value of every condition.
actions.templatesHint: Text fields can include answers and request details: use "Insert value". Values the request doesn't have stay empty.
actions.secretStored: Stored. Leave empty to keep it.
actions.readOnly: You can't change this action: it needs the permission {permission}.
actions.locked: Needs a permission you don't have
actions.unavailable: This action's module is disabled or missing. The action is skipped until it is back.
actions.fixIssues: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem} other {Fix # problems}} first.

searchPlaceholder: Search forms by name or key…
noAccess: You don't have access to manage forms.
audienceGroups: {count, plural, one {Visible to # group} other {Visible to # groups}}

empty.title: No forms match
empty.firstDescription: Create a form, drag in the fields you need and publish it to the request portal.

create.title: New form
create.description: Give the form a name people will recognise. You can add fields and publish it next.
create.name: Name
create.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language
create.keyHint: Used in the portal address (/requests/forms/key). Lowercase letters, digits, - and _; it can't be changed later.
create.keyInvalid: Use 2–64 lowercase letters, digits, - or _, starting with a letter or digit
create.keyTaken: Another form already uses this key

builder.title: Form builder
builder.notFoundDescription: It may have been removed, or the link is wrong.
builder.fieldCount: {count, plural, =0 {No fields yet} one {# field} other {# fields}}
builder.archiveBody: The form disappears from the portal. Requests already made with it keep their history, and you can restore it at any time.
builder.archivedNote: This form is archived: it is hidden from the portal and can't be published until you restore it.
builder.leaveBody: Your changes to this form haven't been saved yet.
builder.fixIssues: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before saving} other {Fix # problems before saving}}
builder.invalidDraft: The form can't be saved in its current state.
builder.publishFirstBody: The form becomes available in the request portal to its audience.
builder.publishBody: People get the new version right away. Requests already submitted keep the version they were made with.
builder.diffAdded: {count, plural, one {# new field} other {# new fields}}
builder.diffLayoutOnly: Only the layout, text or settings changed.

publishBlocked.archived: Restore the form before publishing it
publishBlocked.noFields: Add at least one field before publishing
publishBlocked.issues: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem before publishing} other {Fix # problems before publishing}}
publishBlocked.workflow: The approval isn't published yet, and changing it needs Workflow administrator
publishBlocked.upToDate: Version {version} already matches these fields. Settings take effect when you save.
publishBlocked.approval: {count, plural, one {Fix # problem in the approval before publishing} other {Fix # problems in the approval before publishing}}

builder.paletteHint: Drag onto the form, or click to add below the selected element.
builder.emptyDescription: Drag a field here from the left, or click one to add it.
builder.dropHere: Drop here to add at the end
builder.publishedFieldNote: This field is in the published version, so its key and type are locked: stored answers depend on them.
builder.propertiesEmptyDescription: Select an element on the form to edit its label, options, validation and logic.
builder.issuesSummary: {count, plural, one {# problem to fix — show it} other {# problems to fix — show the first}}
builder.tipDrag: Drag the handle (⋮⋮) to reorder, or focus it and use Space and the arrow keys.
builder.publishApprovalBody: The questions haven't changed. New requests use the new approval; requests already in progress keep theirs.

success.title: Version {version} is live for {audience}
success.titleOff: Version {version} is published. The form is turned off, so nobody can use it yet.

preview.missingTranslations: {count, plural, one {# text has no {language} translation yet; people will see English instead.} other {# texts have no {language} translation yet; people will see English instead.}}
preview.empty: This form has no fields yet.
preview.resultDescription: Submit the sample answers to check the questions and rules. Nothing is sent.
preview.resultEmpty: Submit the form to see what would be stored.
preview.resultInvalid: {count, plural, one {# field needs attention} other {# fields need attention}}
preview.resultNote: Hidden conditional fields are left out, exactly as the server does.
preview.whoDescription: For the sample answers, as the requester you choose. Nothing is sent.
preview.whoNone: Nobody: this form has no approval, so requests go ahead as soon as they're sent.
preview.nextNone: Nothing else: the request is recorded and the requester can follow it in My requests.

settings.detailsDescription: How the form appears in the request portal.
settings.name: Name
settings.categoryHint: Groups forms in the portal. The portal's own categories show in each person's language; a new one shows as you typed it.
settings.availabilityDescription: Who can find this form, and whether it accepts new requests.
settings.activeOn: The published version is open to its audience.
settings.activeOff: Paused: the form is hidden from the portal. Open requests continue.
settings.audienceGroupsHint: Only members of these groups see the form in the portal.
settings.approvalDescription: The workflow that runs when someone submits the form.
settings.noApprovalHint: Requests are recorded as submitted without an approval step.
settings.workflowNotPublished: This workflow isn't published (or was archived). Publish it before publishing the form.
settings.versionsDescription: Every publish creates a new version; requests keep the version they were made with.

issues.nameRequired: Enter a name in at least one language
issues.groupsRequired: Choose at least one group, or make the form available to everyone

settings.activityDescription: Who changed, published or archived this form, newest first.

submissions.title: Requests made with this form
submissions.emptyDescription: Requests made from the portal with this form appear here.

changePreview.invalid: This proposal can’t be previewed: its questions aren’t a valid form.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Checks across fields, run when people send the form and again by the server.
rules.emptyHint: For example: the end date is after the start date, or a rollback plan is required when the risk is high.
rules.noFields: Add fields first: rules compare the answers.
rules.sheetHint: When the answers don’t meet the rule, the form can’t be sent and shows your message.
rules.whenHint: The rule only applies when this holds. Leave it empty to always check.
rules.whenEmpty: No conditions: the rule always applies.
rules.requireHint: What must be true. Compare a field with a value or with another field.
rules.messagePlaceholder: e.g. The end must be after the start
rules.messageHint: Shown to people when the rule isn’t met. Write it in each language they use.
rules.showOnHint: Choose the fields to fix; with none chosen it shows above the form.

issues.requireEmpty: Add at least one condition the answers must meet
issues.conditionIncomplete: Fill in the value of every condition
issues.unknownField: Refers to a field that no longer exists

approval.title: Approval
approval.noAccess: Seeing who approves these requests needs Workflow viewer or Workflow administrator.
approval.noAccessNamed: Requests are approved by “{name}”. Seeing or changing it needs Workflow viewer or Workflow administrator.
approval.emptyDescription: Nobody yet: a request goes ahead as soon as it's sent, and its “After approval” actions run straight away.
approval.setUpHint: Starts with the requester's manager (or their department head). You can change it here.
approval.useExisting: Or use an approval you already have
approval.name: Name of the approval
approval.statusNew: New: published together with the form
approval.statusChanged: Version {version} in use · your changes are published with the form
approval.shared: {count, plural, one {Also used by {names}: changes here apply to it too.} other {Also used by {names}: changes here apply to them too.}}
approval.pendingLink: This form is live: it starts using this approval when you publish.
approval.readOnly: You can see this approval. Changing it needs Workflow administrator.
approval.archived: This approval is archived. Choose another one, or restore it in the workflow designer.

checks.title: Before you publish
checks.recordsNobody: Nobody can be given access to pick {type} records, so “{field}” will always be empty.
checks.recordsSome: Not everyone who can use this form can see {type} records (that needs {roles}), so some people will find nothing to pick in “{field}”.
checks.recordsGroups: Members of {groups} don't get {roles} through those groups, so some of them may find no {type} records to pick in “{field}”.
checks.factNoFallback: If “{field}” has nobody in it, “{step}” finds no approver and the request is rejected.
checks.groupEmpty: The group “{group}” has no active members, so “{step}” would find nobody to ask.
checks.roleEmpty: Nobody holds “{role}”, so “{step}” would find nobody to ask.
